attributes.content:
**EL-RSP-1.4 Rear lamp reaction 10 to 65 ms**

RearLight shall change Lamp_RearLeftTurn and Lamp_RearRightTurn no earlier than 10 ms and no later than 65 ms after receiving a TurnLightControl frame that changes the corresponding request.

description: Allocated to building block RearLighting. Third segment of the EL-RSP-1 budget, rear path. 65 ms is what the LIN hop needs (see RearLight's refinement); with FrontLighting's 10 ms lower bound it gives the 55 ms worst front/rear offset.
